description: Defines UE (User Equipment) context and management structures for a scheduler in a wireless communication system, including cell lookup, UE state management, and handling of various indications and configurations.

classes.name: ue
classes.description: Represents a User Equipment (UE) context within the scheduler, managing state, configurations, and interactions with network components.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Handles slot timing indication for the UE.

methods.name: find_cell
methods.description: Finds a UE cell by its DU cell index.

methods.name: get_cell
methods.description: Retrieves a UE cell by its service cell index.

methods.name: get_pcell
methods.description: Retrieves the primary cell (PCell) of the UE.

methods.name: nof_cells
methods.description: Returns the number of configured cells for the UE.

methods.name: is_ca_enabled
methods.description: Checks if Carrier Aggregation is enabled for the UE.

methods.name: handle_ul_n_ta_update_indication
methods.description: Handles uplink timing advance update indication.

methods.name: handle_dl_mac_ce_indication
methods.description: Handles downlink MAC control element indication.

methods.name: handle_reconfiguration_request
methods.description: Processes new UE configuration during RRC reconfiguration.

methods.name: pending_ul_newtx_bytes
methods.description: Calculates pending uplink bytes not allocated in HARQ.

methods.name: drx_controller
methods.description: Accesses the UE's DRX (Discontinuous Reception) controller.

methods.name: logical_channels
methods.description: Accesses the UE's logical channel repository.
